detail: docs/FOUNDATION-PLAN.md:28 (D2) states "Mutations (status changes, supersede, dismiss) are modeled as new event records referencing the prior ULID, not in-place edits" and that the three v1 aggregates "cease to exist as committed files". The shipped implementation does the opposite on both counts: src/storage/sync/record-export.ts:20-22 docblock — "Mutations rewrite the same file (decision status, entity merge, handoff acknowledge); removals (dismiss, removeEntities) unlink it" — and migrate leaves the v1 aggregates tracked (legacy files are "their own backup", never modified or deleted; docs/UPGRADE-v2.md:36). Consequence for the 2026-09-04 field report (#4): the ULID set-union guarantee covers CREATES only. Two hosts that mutate the same record (updateStatus, linkCommit, amendMetadata, blackboard resolve, handoff acknowledge, entity/relation upsert) before either pulls produce a real textual conflict in records/**/<ulid>.json, which git cannot resolve (no valid merge driver for JSON; merge=union would corrupt it). The field's own conflict table lists only the v1 aggregates and misses this class. Surfaced while planning the response to field issues #3/#4; adversarial verification of the exact mutation-path enumeration is in workflow wf_daceaa5d-eee lane V5.
summary: FOUNDATION-PLAN D2's mutation model was never implemented: record-export.ts rewrites the same ULID file in place on every mutation, so same-record cross-host edits ARE a git conflict class
